name: Fruit cake sliced
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA), EGGS, SUGAR, BAKERY SHORTENING, WATER, PALM OIL, FRUIT CUTS (6%), HUMECTANTS (INS 422, INS 420), LIQUID GLUCOSE, MIXED FRUIT JAM, MILK SOLIDS, INVERT SYRUP, CAKE GEL (INS 471, INS 477, INS 1520, INS 420, INS 412), RAISING AGENT [INS 500(ii)] & BAKING POWDER, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, PRESERVATIVES (INS 282, INS 200), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 260), STABILIZER (INS 412, INS 415), EMULSIFIERS (INS 471, INS 477, INS 322), NATURAL FLAVOUR (LEMON), NATURE-IDENTICAL FLAVOUR (ORANGE) AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOUR (VANILLA). (Numbers in brackets as per International Numbering System). CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, EGG AND SOY INGREDIENTS. POLYOLS MAY HAVE LAXATIVE EFFECTS.
